units.summary: Adds a package-level test hook, nil in production, that compactHeadViewLocked calls between the block write and eviction. Only tests set it, so production behavior does not change.
units.headline: New test hook invoked before head-view eviction
units.reason: Test-only hook that stays nil in production; it only adds a nil check on the compaction path.

units.summary: New function type for building a restricted BlockReader over a time slice of the head. It has no behavior of its own; it is used by compactHeadViewLocked.
units.headline: Adds headViewFactory function type for head-view compaction
units.reason: Type declaration only; the behavior lives in compactHeadViewLocked.

units.summary: New evictor function type taking maxt and an append-ID watermark. Its doc comment says the evictor must keep series that got samples after compaction began, which the watermark does not fully guarantee (see compactHeadViewLocked).
units.headline: Adds headSeriesEvictor type with append-ID watermark contract
units.reason: Type declaration and doc only; the real logic is reviewed in compactHeadViewLocked.

units.summary: Shared loop, pulled out of CompactStaleHead: it writes one block per chunk range for a head view, reloads blocks, skips empty slices, then evicts using an append-ID watermark taken before the writes. The watermark comes from lastAppendID, the last *assigned* ID, which includes appenders that are still open.

issues.title: Watermark includes open appenders; their late commits can be evicted
issues.failure_scenario: An appender is created before compaction, so its append ID is already assigned and <= the watermark. It commits a sample for a selected series at t <= maxt after that slice's block reader took its isolation snapshot. The block lacks the sample, hasAppendIDAbove returns false, the series is evicted, and the sample is lost from the head and dropped on WAL replay.

units.headline: Shared head-view compaction loop with append-ID eviction watermark
units.reason: New eviction-safety logic decides whether samples are lost; this is persistence and concurrency logic.
focus: Whether lastAppendID (last assigned ID) is the right watermark versus the oldest open append ID minus one
Appenders open across the block-write window that commit samples with t <= maxt
Skipping reloadBlocks when uids is empty, and the error/cleanup path after a failed reload

units.summary: CompactStaleHead now delegates to compactHeadViewLocked through NewSelectedSeriesHead and truncateStaleSeries with the watermark. Behavior changes: eviction now also skips series with post-watermark append IDs, empty slices skip reloadBlocks, and the log text changed.
units.headline: CompactStaleHead now uses shared view compaction with watermark guard
units.reason: Changes the eviction predicate and block-write flow on a production compaction path.
focus: Stale-series eviction now also requires !hasAppendIDAbove; check that numStaleSeries accounting still matches
NumSeries of the view is now len(refs) instead of NumStaleSeries(); check the block stats are still correct
